body:
Thanks for the bug report!

Does this happen with all possible inputs, while using your timezone? 
What about other timezones (like Europe\Rome, the one referenced in #19531)?
Can you write a test that reproduces the issue?
Bug is for every timezone.  if i will not set timezone, in this case defaut timezone is used from php.ini.

Hi, i've got the same pb when using bootstrap datetimepicker (with sonata admin). I fixed it setting UTC as timezone for my projets, as my datetime as stored witout time zone in database, it is not a big issue. A way to correct it is to set the timezone, even if inputTimezone and outputTimezone are the same.
So you think that a fix would be setting the default timezone, @sbarbo ?
